response.answer: For medical image segmentation, test-set sizes typically target thousands of samples, with annotation time per minute around 1-2 minutes, and inter-annotator Dice targets of 0.8-0.9 for reliable metrics. Sample size calculations often use power analysis to ensure statistical significance.
